description: This file defines a PHP controller class 'SaveTerminationReasonController' within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. Its main purpose is to prepare and set a Vue component based on the presence of an 'id' attribute in the incoming HTTP request, facilitating the rendering of a termination reason form for editing or creating new entries.

classes.name: SaveTerminationReasonController
classes.description: A controller handling the rendering of a termination reason form, either for editing an existing reason or creating a new one, based on request parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component to be rendered. Checks if 'id' attribute exists in the request to determine whether to load an existing termination reason for editing or to prepare for creating a new one.
